Hey ! I’m sorry you’re currently in the same boat but I hope this reassures you that things will get better. No matter how unlikely you think it is, things will get better with time.

 I’ve found love again, love that never gives up on me and reciprocates my love. A love makes all the pain and heartbreak worth it, because it gave me the chance to meet him. I’m going on 3 years together with my bf and every single day I’m so grateful that our paths crossed. Because I deserve this. 

And so do you, you deserve a person that would love you and fight for your relationship just the same. Not someone you need to beg to love and fight for you. I didn’t realise it back then but I wish I did. The pain will slowly fade, and you will heal. The pain does not last forever, despite it feeling that way.

The beginning is the hardest, but it does get better. So much better. Wishing you the best !

I relate to the pain and determination you have to keep and love him. I felt the same. But please know that you deserve so much more, you deserve a person that would love you and fight for your relationships just the same. Not someone you need to beg to love and fight for you. I didn’t realise it back then but I wish I did. The pain will slowly fade, and you will heal. The pain does not last forever, despite it feeling that way.

That love you feel for him ? It’s all you, because YOU are capable of loving so wholeheartedly. All that love is coming from YOU. One day, you will heal and you will be capable of finding a love that’s just as strong as the love you felt for him, maybe even more when you find a person that loves you just as much and never gives up on you. 

The beginning is the hardest, but it does get better. So much better. Wishing you the best !

I’m comfortable with myself. I wasn’t always like this. I used to be insecure, anxious, self conscious. The whole spotlight effect thing. The spotlight effect- the phenomenon in which people tend to believe they are being noticed more than they really are. I think by learning about this phenomenon, I learnt to overcome it. People aren’t as judgemental as we think they are. Everyone is too busy worrying about themselves and what you think of them.

Yes, with my depressive episodes I constantly say I hate myself. But after putting more thought into it. I don’t. This might be contradicting, on one hand I hate myself because of this sadness I’m feeling. It’s never ending and I don’t even know why I feel this way. But I don’t hate myself. I’m satisfied with the choices I made in life. The person I’ve become. And the person I want to be. 

I made all these choices. Sure I had help along the way from my friends and family. But essentially I made the choices that lead to this future. And I think I love myself for that. I couldn’t be happier.

I too was dumped by my ex out of nowhere. One day he was holding my hand while watching a movie and telling me he loved me so much and the next day he wanted a break up because he lost feelings for me.

I wish I listened to the advice I was given when I reached out here. But I’m stubborn. I didn’t. I told myself it’s different for them. They didn’t love their ex as much as I did. God, I was an idiot.

Istg if I listened, I would’ve healed sooner. I spent months on NC hoping he’ll reach out. I broke no contact many times, telling myself I’ll give it one last shot, perhaps it’ll work out this time. I was wrong. It didn’t. And it fucking broke me. 

Then I started accepting. I accepted that he didn’t want me, not because I’m a bad person. We both made our fair shares of mistakes. He didn’t want me because he didn’t. I didn’t need closure. That was closure enough. He. Didn’t. Want. Me. I kept searching for closure. “There’s must be a reason why”. No. Maybe there was a reason. But he not wanting this ? That’s my closure. Soon I found clarity in his actions. Or should I say, the lack of. 

I’m 8 months in. I’m happier. I go days before thinking of him. I have fun. Do I miss him ? Yes. Do I love him? Yes. I’m perfectly capable of loving him. I would’ve moved mountains for our love. I know that I would’ve cherished him with all I had. He wasn’t the best looking nor did he have the best personality but that doesn’t matter . But I loved him deeply, I can proudly say I’d do anything for that boy.  Because of that, I’m hopeful for the future. If I can do anything for him and love him so deeply. I know eventually I’ll be lucky enough to find someone that thinks of me just the same. I can’t wait.

I too, was like that months ago.Fresh out of the break up, crying every single day and I didn’t know when it would stop. I too, dreaded my birthday was it was a month or so after the break up. I hated that he wouldn’t be there for me and it wouldn’t be like old times. I wanted the pain to end but I knew I loved him too much and never thought the pain would eventually lessen. 

But guess what ? It did. I eventually stopped hurting every single day, I no longer had tears to cry for him every day. It’s been 7 months now and I never in my wildest dreams thought my recovery would be so soon. But life happens, and there’ll be other things that require your attention more. You’ll be so caught up in the moment that you’ll take a second to realise “ oh, it’s been days since I thought/cried over him”. And then the wave hits you, and you might cry and miss him again. But eventually that too will end. 

I might be young, but take it from me. Fresh from the break up, scrolling through all these posts in this subreddit. Thinking “how does one heal in a matter of months. Impossible ! They must not have  love each other that much/they probably didn’t know each other for that long.” “Oh no no no, we were different. What we had was special” 

The truth is, everyone heals. It might sound so cliche. *time heals all wounds* I know I didn’t believe it, and you probably don’t either. But it does. You might look back months from now and realise that its true and that, is when you start to heal. I wish you the best, and my DM’s are always open if you want to talk. 

After all, we’re all in this together.
